acceptance: c8ee1a3f with view-ports and the frozen 64-unit catalogs
method: Standard release, sparse-cells, view-ports and storage-metrics, one excluded warm-up per arm and case, then three fresh processes per arm in alternating order. CLI includes load and export. RSS is the process high-water through inference in bytes. Audit process checked every frozen digest.

heldout_pgo.method: Opposite-workload training, native CPU, fat LTO, one codegen unit. One warm-up (i=0), four alternating measured pairs. Timing builds check schedule and final graph. The separate audit builds check RHS, writes and Spine.

clean_heldout_pgo.method: Each opposite-case-trained executable alternates with the baseline binary in a fresh process. Sample 0 is excluded. Each process checks final state and ordered schedule digest. The fixed historical reference and the contemporary control are reported separately.
clean_heldout_pgo.paired_control: development executable named base; see control_identity

typed_control_heldout.method: Four measured alternating pairs after one warm-up, same fixed programs, separate snapshot full audit, native CPU/fat LTO/one codegen unit, trained exclusively on the other case.
typed_control_heldout.paired_control: development executable named base; see control_identity

ordered_rows_heldout.method: Opposite-case-trained native CPU/fat LTO/one codegen unit. Each clean timing series has one excluded warm-up then seven sum-bits pairs or five Raytrace pairs. Original Raytrace series overlapped an exploratory Python donor analysis and is kept separately, excluded from reported medians.
ordered_rows_heldout.paired_control: development executable named base; see control_identity

arithmetic_heldout.method: Alternating fresh processes with one excluded warm-up, seven measured sum-bits pairs and five Raytrace pairs. Native CPU, fat LTO, one codegen unit. Each case tests a binary trained exclusively on the opposite case. Full standalone audit at the same revision.
arithmetic_heldout.paired_control: development executable named base; see control_identity

single_table_words_heldout.method: Fresh paired standard release baseline and native fat-LTO candidate trained on the opposite workload only. One warm-up, nine sum-bits measured pairs and five Raytrace measured pairs. Every timed child checked the schedule and graph. Separate audited executable at same source commit.
single_table_words_heldout.paired_control: development executable named base; see control_identity

membership_heldout.method: One excluded warm-up; nine sum-bits and five Raytrace alternating pairs with c8ee1a3f. Both profiles trained solely on the opposite workload. Repeat comparison to 98792cd9 used ten sum-bits and three Raytrace measured pairs.
membership_heldout.paired_control: development executable named base; see control_identity

partial_nullary_heldout.method: One warm-up; nine measured sum-bits pairs and five Raytrace pairs. Native CPU, fat LTO, one codegen unit; opposite-workload training only. Every timing process checked schedule and final graph; separate audit checked ordered RHS, writes, Spine and schedule.
partial_nullary_heldout.paired_control: development executable named base; see control_identity

allocation_census.method: Diagnostic mimalloc wrapper counts allocation, zeroed allocation and realloc requests inside the innermost labeled inference phase; bins are <=16,32,64,128,256,512, and greater bytes. Not an elapsed-time measurement. Schedule and final graph hashes checked.

inline_domains_heldout.method: Nine measured sum-bits pairs and five Raytrace pairs after one warm-up. Candidates use the opposite workload profile, native CPU, one codegen unit and fat LTO. Each original/candidate child checks the schedule and final graph; separate full audits check all digests.
inline_domains_heldout.paired_control: development executable named base; see control_identity

control_identity.correction: All raw samples with arm exactly base used the development executable, not the original-bin executable that established the fixed thresholds. They cannot support an archived-original paired ratio.

verified_original_pairs.method: Direct alternation of the SHA-verified original-bin, regular PGO, and enriched PGO of the identical sparse source. Warm-up i=0 excluded. Nine measured sum-bits replicates, five Raytrace replicates per arm. Both candidate policies train exclusively on the opposite case. Enriched instrumentation alone sets LLVM vp-counters-per-site=16.

enriched_development_pairs.paired_control: development executable named base; not the archived reference
